development.note: Initial partial implementation used low. The user explicitly requested max; the low writer was stopped, the same session resumed with max, and exported message metadata verified model.variant=max. Subsequent completion and live selector checks used max.

userDecision.confirmed: New tasks use cheap local assessment before costly skill retrieval (question1 A).
configurableDefaultsNotExplicitUserAnswe: one-run owner approval; no implicit task-wide authorization

behavior.balancedGate: Local deterministic multilingual heuristics and explicit host signals. Not a model call or semantic classifier. Ambiguous tasks cautiously check once; hosts can report needsSkill.
behavior.requiresHostEvents: Pass a stable task identity and real phase/material/error events. No-context callers preserve documented one-shot behavior.
behavior.cacheBoundary: Reuse recommendations/activated instructions only; never replay scripts or count cached output as new execution.
behavior.ownerChoice: Existing per-run ask boundary remains. Changed work that requires execution obtains a fresh run/choice; cached context can continue host work.
